summary: Deployed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker on node1 as a dedicated OpenRC service named inventory-worker, running under a newly created dedicated inventorysvc system account, enabled at the default runlevel. Verified persistence across a full node reboot (boot_id changed, service auto-started, correct user).
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Alpine Linux 3.23 with OpenRC, confirmed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker exists (simple sleep-loop daemon)
Created dedicated system group and user 'inventorysvc' (no login shell, no home) via addgroup -S / adduser -S
Wrote OpenRC service unit /etc/init.d/inventory-worker with command_user=inventorysvc:inventorysvc, command_background=yes, pidfile, and dedicated log file
Fixed log file ownership (/var/log/inventory-worker.log) so the unprivileged user could write to it
Enabled service in default runlevel via rc-update add inventory-worker default
Started service and verified process runs as inventorysvc via ps
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline (49aa44b4-...) and running service state
Triggered a background-delayed reboot on node1 so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed post-reboot (b238215e-...), confirming an actual restart occurred
Verified inventory-worker service auto-started after reboot (new PID) and is running as inventorysvc, confirming persistence/recovery

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker deployed as managed service 'inventory-worker' under dedicated 'inventorysvc' account
evidence.summary: Confirmed binary present, created dedicated inventorysvc user/group, wrote OpenRC unit inventory-worker with command_user=inventorysvc, started it, and confirmed via ps that the process runs as inventorysvc under the inventory-worker service.
rc-update show default lists inventory-worker in the default runlevel both before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: healthy baseline on node1
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (49aa44b4-d33e-45f7-afc7-14beeb80ba36) and confirmed inventory-worker service status 'started' with correct PID/user before reboot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command with short delay so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' successfully before the node disconnected.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Post-reconnect boot_id is b238215e-2512-4290-af2d-b6c614ffb583, different from the pre-restart value, and uptime shows 'up 0 min', proving a genuine reboot occurred.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required service
evidence.summary: After reboot, rc-service inventory-worker status reports 'started', ps shows a new PID (2286) running as inventorysvc, and rc-update confirms it remains enrolled in the default runlevel — service auto-recovered without manual intervention.
